name: Bullet Time
tagline: Time freezes while the camera orbits around you.
subject: the person
motion: Time freezes: {subject} hangs motionless mid-moment, strands of hair and floating dust suspended in the air. The camera glides in a smooth half-orbit around {subject}, revealing them from the side while everything stays perfectly still. Cinematic lighting with crisp detail.
sound: time slowing down into a deep stretched whoosh, a heartbeat, and a low suspended drone
author: Conjure
